It’s like people turned into monsters out of nowhere…
Maybe they were always like this, maybe I just didn’t see through their disguises. Hiding their anger and sheer need to destroy behind smiles and suits.
While walking down the street I pass hundreds of people everyday and I never really cared about any of them. What they feel, what they go through. 
And every single one of these people might be on the verge of breaking, just waiting to get an excuse to engage in violence or ending it all on their own terms.
People who started this protest probably had good intentions, but it’s very easy for an idea to get twisted and transformed into something grotesque. Crowd mentality is a powerful thing, like a force of nature after all.
Now that I witnessed it, I know that there’s no help coming. The police are busy with different, more important things or just too overworked. {{wi}}Or maybe they just don’t care. 
There’s no way for me to know for sure. I’m not a good judge of characters, never was.
{{punch}}Oh, someone just threw a bottle and it landed near my feet.
It’s easy to get caught off guard when in deep thought…
Next time I doze off like this, instead of a bottle it might be a knife, plunged deep inside my rib cage…
I should really limit my activity outside right now. It’s not worth dying out here on the streets and I’m sure there are people that only wait to leave their mark on the world. Just so they can become more important than they really are, just for a second.
Sick of their own insignificance and powerlessness… {{wi}}I know it because some time ago I was like that too…
